features: Start Your Child’s Musical Journey By Gifting Them a Casio Mini Keyboard
The SA-78 Features 44 Mini Sized Keys Which Are a Great Fit For Kids
Explore The 100 Tones and 50 Rhythms and Find an Incredible Variety of Lifelike Instruments
The SA-78 Features 10 Built-In Songs To Play Along with Which’ll Keep Your Little Ones Engaged
Comes with 5 On-Board Percussion Pads Along with a Piano/Organ Button
The LCD Display Acts As a Visual Guide and Makes Learning More Fun For Kids
The SA-78 Comes with a 3.5 mm Jack To Connect Headphones So That Your Child Can Practice In Peace
The SA-78 Comes with a Free Adaptor and Can Also Be Operated via 6 AA Batteries
